name: apex-client
description: Local bridge for ApexTunnel, proxying local traffic to the public internet.

scripts.build:linux-x64: pnpm run bundle && pkg . --target node18-linux-x64 --output dist/apex-linux-x64
scripts.build:linux-arm64: pnpm run bundle && pkg . --target node18-linux-arm64 --output dist/apex-linux-arm64
scripts.build:win-x64: pnpm run bundle && pkg . --target node18-win-x64 --output dist/apex-win-x64
scripts.build:termux: pnpm run bundle && pkg . --target node18-linuxstatic-arm64 --output dist/apex-termux
scripts.build:all: pnpm run build:linux-x64 && pnpm run build:linux-arm64 && pnpm run build:win-x64

author: BraveraTech
